crossRefs.note: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

translations.web: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
translations.bsb: After this, Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country.
translations.kjv: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
translations.asv: And after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
